'''Risa Shimizu''' (Japanese: '''清水理沙''' ''Shimizu Risa'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Shimizu was born on September 9, 1988, in {{wp|Kanagawa}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She started her work in the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, where she voiced [[Charlene]], the apprentice of [[Olympia]]. However, her best known roles were [[Alola]]'s [[Nurse Joy]]s, [[Lana's Primarina|Lana's Brionne and Primarina]], and [[List of recurring wild Pokémon in the animated series|several recurring wild Pokémon]], all of whom appeared in {{aniseries|SM}}. She continued to voice various characters and {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|JN}}, most notably [[Officer Jenny]] and [[Goh's Beedrill]]. Shimizu is currently affiliated with the talent group Aksent.
